whenToUse: Services where reasons fall into a few kinds, such as taxis or delivery.
You want reasons quickly, in one go.
whenNotToUse: Reasons are too varied to fit in chips (use reviews).
You'd show the same chips regardless of score.
Choosing a chip would be required to move on.
accessibility: Chips are aria-pressed toggles that also show a check when chosen.
The chip group is named, such as What went well.
The rating is radio buttons, chosen with the keyboard.
When the score crosses between good and bad, the chosen chips are cleared.
